title: Finance & Administration Coordinator
description:
Finance & Administration Coordinator

Crewe £34,000 Full-Time Permanent

Are you an experienced Finance Administrator, Accounts Assistant, Bookkeeper or Finance Coordinator looking for a varied role within a well-established international manufacturing business?

We are recruiting on behalf of a successful global organisation seeking a Finance & Administration Coordinator to join their team in Crewe. This is a hands-on position offering exposure to finance, administration, payroll coordination and wider business operations.

Working within a close-knit local team, you'll play a key role in ensuring the smooth running of day-to-day financial and administrative activities while liaising with colleagues across multiple international locations.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing supplier invoices and preparing payments.
- Managing daily banking activities, reconciliations and financial records.
- Supporting payroll administration and related documentation.
- Assisting with month-end processes and financial reporting.
- Maintaining cashflow forecasts and monitoring upcoming payments.
- Supporting budgeting activities and annual audits.
- Maintaining employee records and HR documentation.
- Updating fixed asset records and financial spreadsheets.
- Providing general administrative support as required.

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience within finance, accounts, bookkeeping or financial administration.
- Working knowledge of Sage and Microsoft Excel.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Good understanding of invoicing, reconciliations, payments and reporting processes.
- Excellent organisational skills and ability to prioritise workloads.
- Strong communication skills with a proactive approach.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a wider team.

What's on Offer
- Salary up to £34,000.
- Permanent, full-time position.
- Early finish every Friday.
- Company laptop and mobile phone provided.
- Opportunity to work within an international business.
- Supportive team environment with opportunities for professional development.
- Occasional travel opportunities to other UK and European locations.

Working Hours

Monday - Thursday: 7:00am - 4:00pm
Friday: 7:00am - 1:15pm

If you're looking for a varied finance and administration role within a stable and growing international manufacturing business, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Payroll Assistant
description:
Payroll Assistant

Wilmslow

Free Parking

Hybrid working & Flexi-Time

£30,000 - £35,000

This firm of accountants gives you the flexibility and freedom to mould work around your life - and not the other way around.
- Start anytime between 8am - 10am
- 35 hour working week
- Hybrid working
- Extended Christmas shut down

Flexibility is a real thing and not just a buzz word

The owners understand people have commitments outside of work; and they've taken every step possible to accommodate this.

This isn't a flexible working policy where people still feel tied to their desks the owners encourage people to make work fit around their home lives.

Whether that's family, hobbies, missing rush hour traffic or simply having an extra hour in bed before getting up in the morning that's fine with them.

A career path that is shaped around you

Everyone wants the best of all words and here you can. If you're ambitious and looking for progression there's bags of it here.

But equally if you're more focussed on being happy, doing a good job and having a manager that understands that to some people we work to live and not the other way around - you'll find that here.

The working environment described in 3 words:
- Supportive
- Friendly
- Relaxed

What you'll be doing day to day:

Working in a close-knit team of three you will support each other to manage the weekly and monthly payroll for a number of the firms clients.

The role is busy, varied and interesting; you'll get to know your clients well and build strong relationships as you settle into the role.

From calculating pay to handling queries on auto enrolment it's a great position for anyone that likes what they do but want a better environment to do it in.

What experience you will need:

Anyone applying must have previous experience in payroll ideally at a firm of accountants or payroll bureau, although industry payrollers will also be considered.

You will have a positive attitude and be able to work as part of a close knit team.

So if you are looking for a company that really looks after their staff this is a great option for you to consider.

title: FNOL Motor Claims Handler
description:
FNOL Motor Claims Handler

Wilmslow

£24,500 - £27,000 DOE

Monday-Friday 9am-5pm

MPJ Recruitment are proud to be recruiting on behalf of a well-established and growing business within the motor claims sector for an experienced FNOL Claims Handler.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with claims, insurance or customer service experience who enjoys helping customers and managing claims from first notification through to resolution.

The Role

As an FNOL Claims Handler, you will be the first point of contact for customers following a motor incident. You will gather key information, provide support and guidance, and ensure claims are progressed efficiently while delivering an excellent customer experience.

Key responsibilities include:
- Taking incoming claims and accurately recording incident details.
- Handling First Notification of Loss (FNOL) calls.
- Managing claims from initial notification through to the next stage of the process.
- Liaising with customers, insurers, repairers and third-party representatives.
- Updating internal systems with accurate claim information.
- Providing clear and professional communication throughout the customer journey.
- Ensuring all regulatory and company procedures are followed.
- Delivering outstanding customer service at every stage of the claim.

What We're Looking For
- Previous FNOL, motor claims or insurance experience would be advantageous.
- Strong telephone and customer service skills.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- Ability to manage workloads in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong communication and organisational skills.
- A positive and professional approach to customer service.

Package
- Salary up to £27,000 depending on experience.
- Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm.
- Office-based role in Wilmslow.
- 22 days annual leave plus Bank Holidays.
- One Saturday every six weeks, paid at 1.5x your normal rate.
- Overtime available at 1.5x your normal rate.
- Company pension.
- Ongoing training and development.
- Supportive and friendly team environment.
- Genuine opportunities for career progression.

If you're looking to develop your career within the insurance and claims industry and want to join a business that invests in its people, we'd love to hear from you.
